prompt:
Hey, you're the Video Analyzer agent. I have a 2-hour screen recording of me demoing Mission Control to a friend on Discord. This is the richest data source MC has ever had. I need you to process it.

The video is at: C:\Users\ephra\Videos\NVIDIA\Desktop\Desktop 2026.03.07 - 00.20.50.21.mp4
It's 15GB (NVIDIA recording at full bitrate). You need to extract audio first.

Step 1: Extract audio (don't touch the video directly)
Run: ffmpeg -i "C:\Users\ephra\Videos\NVIDIA\Desktop\Desktop 2026.03.07 - 00.20.50.21.mp4" -vn -acodec libmp3lame -q:a 4 "C:\Users\ephra\Videos\demo-session-audio.mp3"
This will take a few minutes. Wait for it.

Step 2: Transcribe
Use whisper or any available transcription tool. If whisper isn't installed, check if there's a Python whisper package available, or use the Bash tool to find what's available. Save transcript to: .claude/agent-hub/coordinated-sprint/demo-transcript.txt

Step 3: First-pass analysis
Read the full transcript and produce a structured analysis document. Model the output after the /cost page's "Prompt Engineering for Cost" style: clean data cards with KEY METRIC badges, INSIGHT badges, section headers, and actionable takeaways. NOT a wall of text.

Structure your analysis as:

OVERVIEW CARD: Session duration, estimated talk time, number of topics covered, key participants

VALUE PROPOSITION GEMS: Direct quotes where Ephratah articulates why MC matters. These are gold. Tag each with context.

FUTURE IDEAS: Things mentioned as "we should do X" or "imagine if Y." Each one becomes a potential dispatch item. Tag as [stated] vs [inferred].

AUDIENCE REACTIONS: Where the friend reacted, asked questions, seemed confused or impressed. This tells us what lands and what doesn't.

PAIN POINTS DISCUSSED: Friction points mentioned during the demo. Cross-reference with existing findings in .claude/agent-hub/findings.json.

STRATEGIC INSIGHTS: High-level observations about MC's direction, identity, and positioning.

KEY QUOTES: The 10-15 most important sentences from the entire recording. These feed into /why and the President's Report.

Write your output to: .claude/agent-hub/coordinated-sprint/video-analysis.md
Also write raw extracted quotes to: .claude/agent-hub/coordinated-sprint/video-quotes.md

Read CLAUDE.md at C:\Users\ephra\phredomade\CLAUDE.md first.

IMPORTANT: This will be a long-running task. The ffmpeg extraction alone may take 5+ minutes. The transcription may take longer. Be patient. Don't skip steps.

DON'T touch any MC code files. You're analyzing, not building.

Start with the ffmpeg extraction immediately.

Should you compress it first before doing it? You don't need to go through a 15 GB file. You can compress in some way. This is engineering simply. I don't know why you need to do it that way. Sorry to interrupt you.
